issue.title: Unable to parse elastic response with pretty=true

repository.name: elasticsearch-net
repository.description: This strongly-typed, client library enables working with Elasticsearch. It is the official client maintained and supported by Elastic.

issue.body:
**NEST/Elasticsearch.Net version**: 5.0.0-beta1

**Elasticsearch version**: 5.0.0-beta1

The Elasticsearch.Net low level client does not work when pretty=true is enabled on my clients connection settings. When I disable pretty=true, it works just fine. 

Below here I have linked a pastebin containing a json document which was returned from ElasticSearch with pretty=true and could not be parsed by my nest client.

http://pastebin.com/L7wzeJ1i

The following response is returned in DebugInformation:

"Unsuccessful low level call on GET: /customer_index/product/_search?pretty=true\r\n# Audit trail of this API call:\r\n - [1] AllNodesDead: Took: 00:00:00\r\n - [2] Resurrection: Node: http://192.168.0.39:9200/ Took: 00:00:00\r\n - [3] PingSuccess: Node: http://192.168.0.39:9200/ Took: 00:00:00.2932808\r\n - [4] BadResponse: Node: http://192.168.0.39:9200/ Took: 00:00:00.0005026\r\n# OriginalException: System.Net.WebException: The server cause a ProtocolViolationException. Section=ResponseStatusLine\r\n   ved System.Net.HttpWebRequest.GetResponse()\r\n   ved Elasticsearch.Net.HttpConnection.Request[TReturn](RequestData requestData)\r\n# Request:\r\n<Request stream not captured or already read to completion by serializer. Set DisableDirectStreaming() on ConnectionSettings to force it to be set on the response.>\r\n# Response:\r\n<Response stream not captured or already read to completion by serializer. Set DisableDirectStreaming() on ConnectionSettings to force it to be set on the response.>\r\n"

body:
Additionally, the header is wrong. From RFC 2616:

> `The Content-Length entity-header field indicates the size of the entity-body, in decimal number of OCTETs, sent to the recipient or, in the case of the HEAD method, the size of the entity-body that would have been sent had the request been a GET.`

We have a short-term fix for REST main action that will address this issue so that there is not a body. We have a plan to address all HEAD methods as a future follow up (so that the content-length header is correct). There will be a PR from @nik9000 shortly.

issue.title: Make sure HEAD / has 0 Content-Length

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Before this commit `curl -XHEAD localhost:9200?pretty` would return
`Content-Length: 1` and a body which is fairly upsetting to standards
compliant tools. Now it'll return `Content-Length: 0` with an empty
body like every other `HEAD` request.

Relates to #21075

body: I've opened the short term workaround (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/21077) and we'll repurpose this issue for the long term, fully rfc compliant fix.
We'll open a new issue for the content-length piece and relate it here.

> We'll open a new issue for the content-length piece and relate it here.

Partially addressed in #21123.
